description: Information architecture: 14 flat top-level views plus a ~10-icon unlabeled toolbar, with overlapping Dashboard/Graph/Items and confusing Pipeline vs Pipeline Editor. Built as seven labelled rooms (Home, Roadmap, Ideas, Review, Build, Fleet, Library) with a tab row inside each, the Settings gear, and one explicit Feature focus chip; the header and sidebar counts are labelled.
phase: COMP-AUDIT: 2026-07 Cockpit Wiring, Completeness & UX Audit
